articles.title: Tether pushes into private credit with $400 million fund with Fasanara
articles.snippet: The USDT issuer will help source lending opportunities and provide stablecoin payment infrastructure for Fasanara's private credit network.

articles.title: Crypto Long & Short: Inside the 300-to-1 onchain gap between the dollar and euro
articles.snippet: Ryan Connor of RockawayX writes that the dollar leads the euro about 3 to 1 across the offchain economy and more than 300 to 1 onchain. Euro-pegged stablecoins total €711 million, under 1% of supply. He traces the gap to path dependency and missing euro DeFi infrastructure, and argues MiCA-regulated issuance and euro vault rails are changing it.

articles.title: PayPal expands stablecoin rails with custom token issuance platform
articles.snippet: The PYUSDx stablecoin developer platform, backed by PayPal USD (PYUSD), is built with the help of M0 and MoonPay.

articles.title: U.S. Bank takes next step towards launching its stablecoin with cross-border payment test
articles.snippet: The fifth-largest U.S. commercial bank said it is exploring USBDC stablecoin for treasury payments, liquidity management and collateral after completing a live transaction.

articles.title: U.S. Bank tests proprietary stablecoin in cross-border Stellar transaction
articles.snippet: The pilot moved USBDC between the bank’s North American and European entities on the public Stellar blockchain.
